# Abyssale Node.js SDK

## What is Abyssale?

Abyssale is a programmatic creative asset generation API. It lets developers generate
marketing visuals, ad creatives, animated GIFs, HTML5 banners, videos, and print-ready
PDFs at scale — directly from code. Design a template once in the Abyssale editor, then
generate thousands of personalised variations via a single API call, substituting text,
images, colors, and other properties dynamically.

## What is this SDK?

`@abyssale/sdk` is the official Node.js / TypeScript SDK for the Abyssale REST API.
It provides a zero-config singleton with 17 typed methods covering the full API surface,
plus built-in polling helpers with exponential backoff. Configuration is done via the
`ABYSSALE_API_KEY` environment variable. The SDK ships as dual ESM/CJS with full
TypeScript types generated from the OpenAPI spec.

## Installation

```
npm install @abyssale/sdk
```

Set the environment variable `ABYSSALE_API_KEY` to your Abyssale API key.

## Methods

- `listDesigns(query?)` — List all designs in the workspace, with optional filtering by project or type
- `getDesign(designId)` — Get full details of a design including formats, elements, and template variables
- `getDesignFormat(designId, formatSpecifier)` — Get details for a specific format within a design
- `generateImage(designId, body)` — Synchronously generate a single image; returns the file URL immediately
- `generateMultiFormatMedia(designId, body)` — Asynchronously generate multiple formats (image, GIF, video, HTML5, PDF) in one call
- `generateMultiPagePdf(designId, body)` — Asynchronously generate a multi-page print-ready PDF from a printer_multipage design
- `getGenerationRequest(generationRequestId)` — Poll the status of an async generation request once
- `waitForGenerationRequest(generationRequestId, options?)` — Poll with exponential backoff until complete; throws on timeout
- `waitForDuplicationRequest(duplicateRequestId, options?)` — Poll template duplication until COMPLETED or ERROR
- `getFile(bannerId)` — Retrieve metadata and CDN download URL for a generated file
- `listFonts()` — List all fonts available in the workspace (Google Fonts + custom uploads)
- `listProjects()` — List all projects in the workspace
- `createProject(body)` — Create a new project to organise designs
- `exportBanners(body)` — Asynchronously package a set of banners into a ZIP archive for download
- `createDynamicImageUrl(designId, body)` — Create a live image URL that renders on-the-fly from query parameters
- `duplicateWorkspaceTemplate(companyTemplateId, body)` — Copy a shared workspace template into a project
- `getDuplicationRequest(duplicateRequestId)` — Poll the status of a template duplication request

## Common use cases

- **Personalised email headers**: Generate a unique image per recipient with their name, company logo, and offer — served via a dynamic image URL that renders on email open, no pre-generation needed.
- **Bulk ad creative production**: Send a CSV of product data and generate hundreds of social media creatives (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Google Display) in every required format in a single async call.
- **E-commerce product banners**: Dynamically swap product image, price, and promotional text into a branded template for each SKU, triggered automatically when inventory or pricing changes.
- **Print-on-demand**: Generate personalised multi-page PDFs (brochures, catalogues, certificates) with different content per page, ready for commercial printing with crop marks and color profiles.
- **HTML5 banner ads**: Produce animated HTML5 banners for ad networks (Google Campaign Manager, Sizmek) with click-tag and backup image, directly from your design templates.
- **Website social cards**: Generate Open Graph and Twitter Card images on demand for any page, with the page title and thumbnail baked in.

## Key features

- TypeScript-first with types generated from the OpenAPI spec — full IntelliSense
- Dual ESM and CJS output — works in any Node.js project
- Zero-config singleton — no constructor, no setup beyond setting an env var
- Auto-retry with exponential backoff on 429 and 5xx errors (default: 3 retries, 30 s timeout — configurable via `ABYSSALE_MAX_RETRIES` and `ABYSSALE_TIMEOUT_MS`)
- Built-in polling helpers (`waitForGenerationRequest`, `waitForDuplicationRequest`) with exponential backoff, jitter, and configurable timeout (default 30 min, min 1 min)
- Returns `{ data, error }` — never throws on HTTP errors
